::: {#exm-deviance-drop}

#### Testing the treatment effect

In the six-patient trial, $q = 1$.

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
# drop in deviance, the likelihood ratio statistic
wf_g2 <- wf_fit$null.deviance - deviance(wf_fit)
# its p-value from the chi-square distribution with 1 degree of freedom
wf_g2_p <- pchisq(wf_g2, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
c(statistic = wf_g2, p_value = wf_g2_p)
```

The statistic is $`r round(wf_g2, 3)`$ with p-value $`r round(wf_g2_p, 2)`$,
so six patients give no evidence of a treatment effect.

:::
